tasks.name: קוד גריי הפוך
tasks.note: Inverse Gray code: prefix XOR of the bits from the top down (a^a>>1^a>>2^a>>3).

tasks.name: הביט הדלוק הנמוך
tasks.note: Isolates the lowest set bit (a AND -a), giving 1, 2, 4 or 8, and 0 for 0.

tasks.name: אפסים מובילים
tasks.src: a=>{ let n=4; while(a){ a>>=1; n--; } return n; }
tasks.note: Count of leading zero bits in a 4-bit number (4 for 0, 0 for 8..15).

tasks.name: החלף ביטים שכנים
tasks.note: Swaps bit 0 with bit 1 and bit 2 with bit 3, using two masks and shifts in both directions.

tasks.name: הפוך את ביט ב
tasks.note: Toggles the bit of a whose index is b mod 4 (a variable-position flag flip).

tasks.name: יום בשבוע אחרי ב ימים
tasks.note: Calendar arithmetic: day index a plus b days, reduced mod 7 instead of mod 16.

tasks.name: ספרת האחדות של המכפלה
tasks.note: Last decimal digit of the product a*b, a non-power-of-two modulus on a value up to 225.

tasks.name: שארית א חלקי ב
tasks.note: Remainder a mod b by repeated subtraction, with a mod 0 defined as a.

tasks.name: חיבור רווי עם סימן
tasks.note: Signed 4-bit addition (8..15 = -8..-1) that saturates at 7 and -8 instead of wrapping.

tasks.name: מיזוג ביטים לפי מסכה
tasks.note: Bitwise multiplexer: each bit comes from a where mask c has a 1 and from b where it has a 0.

tasks.name: קבע את ביט ב לערך ג
tasks.note: Writes the parity bit of c into bit (b mod 4) of a: set it if c is odd, clear it if c is even.

tasks.name: הוסף למלאי עד הקיבולת
tasks.note: Saturating add with a variable cap: stock a plus b units, limited to capacity c.
